title: Easy Smoky Italian Black Pudding Pasta
description: A smoky and light Italian dish featuring black pudding, perfect for a post-workout meal, and made with binchotan-charcoal for a unique flavor
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the sliced black pudding, cooking until browned on both sides
Remove the black pudding from the skillet and set aside, then add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant
Add the halved cherry tomatoes to the skillet and cook for 3 minutes until they start to release their juices
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, tossing to combine with the garlic and cherry tomatoes
Add the grated parmesan cheese to the pasta and toss to combine
Add the cooked black pudding back to the pasta and toss to combine
Season the pasta with salt and black pepper to taste
Garnish the pasta with chopped basil and serve immediately
Light the binchotan-charcoal and place it on the table to infuse the dish with a smoky flavor
